# <zbk-dialog>

A modal dialog built on native `<dialog>`. It opens through `show()` or the
reflected `open` attribute, places focus inside, and releases containment on
every close path.

Base class: `.zbk-dialog`. Variant classes: `.zbk-dialog--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-dialog-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- The user must make or acknowledge one decision before returning to the page.
- A short form needs modal context and explicit completion or cancellation.
- NOT Content should remain non-modal while the page stays interactive. → Use a popover for an anchored overlay or zbk-panel for in-flow retained content.
- NOT The content is a self-contained expandable section. → Use a disclosure pattern.

## Guidance

- Keep a dialog one decision deep; split multi-step workflows into pages or a purpose-built flow.
- Use direct destructive-action wording: name what will be deleted and whether it can be recovered.
- Open with show() or the open attribute. Do not query the internal dialog or call showModal() yourself.
- The component never adds body classes or inline styles; native top-layer modality and the inert fallback contain interaction.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the dialog is modal-open. Adding the attribute calls `showModal()`; it is never forwarded as a template-authored native `open` attribute. |
| `closedby` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native light-dismiss policy, forwarded where the browser supports it. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The dialog body content. | — |
| `title` | The authored heading element. The component preserves its level and wires it to aria-labelledby. | — |
| `footer` | The trailing action row, typically buttons. An element carrying data-close closes the dialog declaratively. | — |

- `title`: Supply an h2, h3, or other heading level appropriate to the surrounding page hierarchy.

## Keyboard

- `Escape` — Closes the native modal dialog unless its cancel event is prevented.
- `Tab / Shift+Tab` — Moves among focusable content while native dialog modality or the inert fallback contains focus.

## Events

- `zbk-close` — The dialog closed. `detail.returnValue` is the native dialog return value.

## Examples

**Confirm a destructive action**

```html
<zbk-dialog><h2 slot="title">Delete workspace?</h2><p>This permanently removes the workspace and its 14 projects.</p><div slot="footer"><zbk-button data-close variant="ghost">Cancel</zbk-button><zbk-button>Delete</zbk-button></div></zbk-dialog>
```

The title names the decision, the consequence is visible, and cancellation is declarative.

**Form dialog**

```html
<zbk-dialog variant="lg"><h2 slot="title">Invite a teammate</h2><form method="dialog"><zbk-input name="email" type="email" required>Email</zbk-input><zbk-button type="submit" value="invite">Send invite</zbk-button></form></zbk-dialog>
```

method="dialog" lets the platform close the dialog and carry the submit button value into zbk-close.

**Light-dismiss dialog**

```html
<zbk-dialog closedby="any" variant="sm"><h2 slot="title">Keyboard shortcuts</h2><p>Press Command+K to open search.</p><div slot="footer"><zbk-button data-close>Done</zbk-button></div></zbk-dialog>
```

closedby="any" opts into native light dismissal where supported without adding a second dismissal implementation.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-dialog-canvas` | `{app.canvas}` | color | — | Dialog surface background. |
| `--zbk-dialog-ink` | `{app.ink}` | color | — | Dialog body text color. |
| `--zbk-dialog-border-color` | `{color.global-transparent}` | color | — | Dialog border color. |
| `--zbk-dialog-border-width` | `{border.width-sm}` | dimension | — | Dialog border width. |
| `--zbk-dialog-border-style` | `{border.style}` | strokeStyle | — | Dialog border style. |
| `--zbk-dialog-border-radius` | `{border.radius-lg}` | dimension | — | Dialog corner radius. |
| `--zbk-dialog-padding-inline` | `{spacing.lg}` | dimension | — | Inline padding inside the dialog. |
| `--zbk-dialog-padding-block` | `{spacing.lg}` | dimension | — | Block padding inside the dialog. |
| `--zbk-dialog-width` | `32rem` | dimension | — | Preferred dialog width. |
| `--zbk-dialog-max-width` | `calc(100vw - 2 * var(--zbk-spacing-lg))` | cssDimension | — | Maximum inline size, leaving viewport breathing room. |
| `--zbk-dialog-max-height` | `85vh` | cssDimension | — | Maximum dialog block size before the content area scrolls. |
| `--zbk-dialog-gap` | `{spacing.md}` | dimension | — | Gap between title, content, and footer. |
| `--zbk-dialog-box-shadow` | `{elevation.xl}` | shadow | — | Dialog elevation. |
| `--zbk-dialog-backdrop-canvas` | `{app.canvas-inverse}` | color | — | Modal backdrop color. |
| `--zbk-dialog-backdrop-opacity` | `{opacity.50}` | number | — | Modal backdrop opacity. |
| `--zbk-dialog-backdrop-blur` | `0px` | dimension | — | Modal backdrop blur radius. |
| `--zbk-dialog-title-ink` | `{app.ink-emphasis}` | color | — | Dialog title color. |
| `--zbk-dialog-title-font-family` | `{font-family.interface}` | fontFamily | — | Dialog title font family. |
| `--zbk-dialog-title-font-size` | `{font-size.lg}` | cssDimension | — | Dialog title font size. |
| `--zbk-dialog-title-font-weight` | `{font-weight.bold}` | fontWeight | — | Dialog title font weight. |
| `--zbk-dialog-footer-gap` | `{spacing.sm}` | dimension | — | Gap between footer actions. |
| `--zbk-dialog-footer-justify` | `flex-end` | flex | — | Footer action alignment. |
| `--zbk-dialog-font-family` | `{font-family.interface}` | fontFamily | — | Dialog body font family. |
| `--zbk-dialog-font-size` | `{font-size.md}` | cssDimension | — | Dialog body font size. |
| `--zbk-dialog-line-height` | `{line-height.2}` | number | — | Dialog body line height. |
| `--zbk-dialog-transition-duration` | `{transition.calm-fx-duration-default}` | duration | — | Duration reserved for dialog and backdrop visual effects. **(a11y)** |
| `--zbk-dialog-transition-timing-function` | `{transition.calm-fx-function-default}` | cubicBezier | — | Timing function reserved for dialog and backdrop visual effects. |

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lg` (situational) | size | `zbk-dialog--lg` | A wider 44rem dialog for forms and denser content. | width: 44rem |
| `sm` | size | `zbk-dialog--sm` | A compact 24rem dialog for one short decision. | width: 24rem |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-dialog.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "dialog": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-dialog--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-button>`.
